name: Root
grammar: grammar Root { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @root @mapping(Result) Root ::= ''; }

name: Sequence
grammar: grammar Sequence { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= '😀' @value '' 'b'; }

name: Choice
grammar: grammar Choice { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= Item @value; Item ::= '' | 'a' | '😀' '' | '😀'; }

name: CaptureRollback
grammar: grammar CaptureRollback { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @root @mapping(Root, params=[value, other]) Root ::= 'a' @value '' | 'a' @other; }

name: OptionalRepeat
grammar: grammar OptionalRepeat { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @root @mapping(Root, params=[value, maybe, many, more]) Root ::= 'a' @value [ '' @maybe ] { '' @many } [ 'x' '' ] { 'y' '' } ( '' | 'b' ) @more; }

name: Progress
grammar: grammar Progress { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= 'a' @value Tail; Tail ::= ''+ | ''{0,3} 'c' | '' % ',' | { [ '' ] } 'e' | 'd'; }

name: Trivia
grammar: grammar Trivia { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @whitespace: javaStyle @root @mapping(Root, params=[value, tail]) Root ::= 'a' @value [ '' ] ( '' 'z' | 'b' @tail ); }

name: MatchedCursor
grammar: grammar MatchedCursor { @package: org.example.emptyliteral token LB = LOOKAHEAD('b') @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= 'a' @value LB '' | 'a' @value LB [ '' ]; }

name: DeclarativeToken
grammar: grammar DeclarativeToken { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2 token EMPTY ::= ''; token NE ::= NEGATIVE_LOOKAHEAD('') 'q'; token LA ::= LOOKAHEAD('') 'p'; token OPT ::= 'r' [ '' ]; @root @mapping(Root, params=[value, rest]) Root ::= EMPTY 'a' @value ( NE | LA | OPT | '' ) @rest; }

name: TokenStream
grammar: grammar TokenStream { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2 @tokenStream: enabled @whitespace: javaStyle token NAME ::= CHAR_RANGE('a','z')+; token SEMI ::= ';'; @root @mapping(Root, params=[value, tail]) Root ::= NAME @value [ '' ] ( '' SEMI @tail | '' ); }

name: LexicalContext
grammar: grammar LexicalContext { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2 token ID ::= CHAR_RANGE('a','z')+; @root @mapping(Root, params=[name, tail]) @lexicalContext(tokens=['ID'], literals=['=']) Root ::= ID @name '' [ '' ] ( '' '=' | '=' ) ID @tail; }

name: AssociativePrefix
grammar: grammar AssociativePrefix { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @whitespace: none @root @mapping(Binary, params=[left, op, right]) @leftAssoc @precedence(level=10) Root ::= '' 'a' @left { '+' @op 'a' @right }; }

name: AssociativeTail
grammar: grammar AssociativeTail { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @whitespace: none @root @mapping(Binary, params=[left, op, right]) @leftAssoc @precedence(level=10) Root ::= 'a' @left { '+' @op '' 'a' @right }; }

name: Cut
grammar: grammar Cut { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= 'a' @value COMMIT('') | 'b' @value [ COMMIT('', 'never') ] | 'a' @value 'c'; }

name: Labeled
grammar: grammar Labeled { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= CATCH('a' @value LABEL(L, ''), 'a' @value 'b', L) | 'c' @value LABEL(M, ''); }

name: Stack
grammar: grammar Stack { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= 'a' @value [ Item ]; Item ::= 'b' '' | Inner; Inner ::= '😀' ''; }

name: AutoCommit
grammar: grammar AutoCommit { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) @autoCommit Root ::= 'a' Name @value '' | 'b' Name @value; Name ::= 'n'; }

name: LexicalContextChoice
grammar: grammar LexicalContextChoice { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2 token ID ::= CHAR_RANGE('a','z')+; @root @mapping(Root, params=[name, tail]) Root ::= Name @name Rest @tail; @lexicalContext(tokens=['ID']) Name ::= ID; Rest ::= '' '=' | '=' 'x'; }

name: TokenStreamChoice
grammar: grammar TokenStreamChoice { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2 @tokenStream: enabled @whitespace: javaStyle token NAME ::= CHAR_RANGE('a','z')+; token SEMI ::= ';'; @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= Item @value; Item ::= '' SEMI | COMMIT(NAME) SEMI; }

name: TokenStreamCommitRepeat
grammar: grammar TokenStreamCommitRepeat { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2 @tokenStream: enabled @whitespace: javaStyle token NAME ::= CHAR_RANGE('a','z')+; token SEMI ::= ';'; @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= NAME @value { COMMIT('') } SEMI; }

name: LexicalContextCommitRepeat
grammar: grammar LexicalContextCommitRepeat { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2 token ID ::= CHAR_RANGE('a','z')+; @root @mapping(Root, params=[name, tail]) @lexicalContext(tokens=['ID'], literals=['=']) Root ::= ID @name { COMMIT('') } '=' ID @tail; }

name: CaughtLabelRepeat
grammar: grammar CaughtLabelRepeat { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= 'a' @value CATCH({ LABEL(L, '') } 'x', 'y', L); }

name: TokenStreamInvertRoot
grammar: grammar TokenStreamInvertRoot { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2 @tokenStream: enabled @root @mapping(Root) Root ::= 'ab'; }

name: LexicalInvertRoot
grammar: grammar LexicalInvertRoot { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2  @root @mapping(Root) @lexicalContext(tokens=[], literals=['ab','abc']) Root ::= 'ab'; }

name: LexicalInvertOutside
grammar: grammar LexicalInvertOutside { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2  @root @mapping(Root) Root ::= 'ab'; @lexicalContext(tokens=[], literals=['x']) Other ::= 'x'; }

name: TokenStreamInvertOptional
grammar: grammar TokenStreamInvertOptional { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2 @tokenStream: enabled @root @mapping(Root) Root ::= [ 'ab' ]; }

name: LexicalInvertOptional
grammar: grammar LexicalInvertOptional { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2  @root @mapping(Root) @lexicalContext(tokens=[], literals=['ab','abc']) Root ::= [ 'ab' ]; }

name: TokenStreamInvertRepeat
grammar: grammar TokenStreamInvertRepeat { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2 @tokenStream: enabled @root @mapping(Root) Root ::= { 'ab' }; }

name: TokenStreamInvertSequence
grammar: grammar TokenStreamInvertSequence { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2 @tokenStream: enabled @root @mapping(Root) Root ::= 'ab' 'cd'; }

name: WordInvertControl
grammar: grammar WordInvertControl { @package: org.example.emptyliteral @ubnf: v2  @root @mapping(Root) Root ::= 'ab'; }
